topic: Choose a cloud provider for hosting our web app

scenario.topic: Choose a cloud provider for hosting our web app
scenario.opening_question: What trade-offs are we willing to make between cost, performance, and ease of management for hosting our web app?

options.name: Amazon EC2 with Reserved Instances
options.upside: Predictable cost with good performance and scalability
options.tradeoff: Requires upfront commitment and some management overhead
options.concern: Complex pricing and potential underutilization of reserved capacity
options.best_for: teams prioritizing cost predictability and scalability

options.name: Google App Engine Standard Environment
options.upside: Fully managed platform with automatic scaling and minimal maintenance
options.tradeoff: Higher latency and less control over infrastructure
options.concern: Potential vendor lock-in and limited customization
options.best_for: teams valuing ease of management and quick deployment

options.name: Microsoft Azure Virtual Machines Pay-As-You-Go
options.upside: Flexible infrastructure with no upfront commitment
options.tradeoff: Higher management effort and potentially variable monthly costs
options.concern: Requires in-house expertise to optimize and maintain
options.best_for: teams needing flexibility and willing to manage infrastructure

options.name: DigitalOcean Droplets with Managed Databases
options.upside: Lower cost option with simple setup and managed database service
options.tradeoff: Higher latency and fewer advanced features compared to larger providers
options.concern: May not scale well for sudden traffic spikes
options.best_for: teams prioritizing cost savings and straightforward management

shared_context: The team has exactly 3 members deciding together
The web app needs to be live within 2 months
The monthly hosting budget is capped at $1500

personas.name: Rina
personas.background: I focus on balancing cost efficiency with manageable operational effort for our team.
personas.private_goal: I want a solution that saves costs without adding too much complexity to management.
